comingLast.roast: done on 17 - every finisher from here is must-watch television
a 1-point cushion over Rava - thin ice, heavy walker
finished with a 3-point buffer - his group is still reminding him hourly
his round is over, his sweating is not - 4 above the line
finished 4 above the blue line - toasting every point Rava does not score
in the clubhouse 4 above Rava - cheering for him from a safe distance
a 4-point moat between him and Rava's crown - shallow moat
in with a 5-point moat - drawbridge stuck halfway up
in the clubhouse 5 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
